scope: native UI preimage only; no credentials

nativeFiles.content:
<!--history.wxml-->
<navigation-bar title="我的错题本" back="{{true}}" color="black" background="#f3efe7"></navigation-bar>
<scroll-view class="page" scroll-y type="list">
  <view class="search-bar" wx:if="{{records.length}}">
    <input
      class="search-input"
      placeholder="搜索错题关键词或考点…"
      placeholder-class="ph"
      value="{{searchKey}}"
      bindinput="onSearch"
      confirm-type="search"
    />
  </view>

  <scroll-view class="filter-bar" scroll-x wx:if="{{records.length}}">
    <view
      class="filter-tag {{activeFilter === kp ? 'active' : ''}}"
      wx:for="{{filters}}"
      wx:for-item="kp"
      wx:key="*this"
      data-kp="{{kp}}"
      bindtap="onFilterTap"
    >{{kp}}</view>
  </scroll-view>

  <view class="empty" wx:if="{{!filtered.length}}">
    <view class="empty-icon">空</view>
    <view class="empty-text">{{records.length ? '没有匹配的错题' : '错题本还是空的，去诊断第一道错题吧'}}</view>
  </view>

  <view class="record" hover-class="record-hover" wx:for="{{filtered}}" wx:key="id" data-id="{{item.id}}" bindtap="viewRecord">
    <view class="record-main">
      <view class="record-q">{{item.question}}</view>
      <view class="record-meta">
        <text class="record-kp" wx:if="{{item.result.knowledgePoint}}">{{item.result.knowledgePoint}}</text>
        <text class="record-time">{{item.time}}</text>
      </view>
    </view>
    <view class="record-del" catchtap="removeRecord" data-id="{{item.id}}">删除</view>
  </view>

  <view class="clear-wrap" wx:if="{{records.length}}">
    <view class="clear-btn" bindtap="clearAll">清空错题本</view>
  </view>
</scroll-view>

<!--index.wxml-->
<navigation-bar title="错因智诊" back="{{false}}" color="white" background="#3c5c5b"></navigation-bar>
<scroll-view class="page" scroll-y type="list">
  <view class="brand">
    <view class="brand-title">错因智诊</view>
    <view class="brand-divider"></view>
    <view class="brand-sub">AI 驱动的理科错题智能诊断助手</view>
  </view>

  <view class="entry" hover-class="entry-hover" bindtap="goInput">
    <view class="entry-icon"><text class="entry-icon-text">录</text></view>
    <view class="entry-body">
      <view class="entry-title">手动输入错题</view>
      <view class="entry-desc">填写题干与错误作答，AI 精准诊断</view>
    </view>
    <view class="entry-arrow">></view>
  </view>

  <view class="entry" hover-class="entry-hover" bindtap="goCamera">
    <view class="entry-icon"><text class="entry-icon-text">拍</text></view>
    <view class="entry-body">
      <view class="entry-title">拍照识别错题</view>
      <view class="entry-desc">{{recognizing ? 'AI 识别中…' : '拍一张照片，AI 自动转录题目文字'}}</view>
    </view>
    <view class="entry-arrow">></view>
  </view>

  <view class="entry" hover-class="entry-hover" bindtap="goHistory">
    <view class="entry-icon"><text class="entry-icon-text">本</text></view>
    <view class="entry-body">
      <view class="entry-title">我的错题本</view>
      <view class="entry-desc">历史诊断记录，随时复习巩固</view>
    </view>
    <view class="entry-arrow">></view>
  </view>

  <view class="entry" hover-class="entry-hover" bindtap="goStats">
    <view class="entry-icon"><text class="entry-icon-text">析</text></view>
    <view class="entry-body">
      <view class="entry-title">学情分析</view>
      <view class="entry-desc">考点分布与错因节点统计，找到薄弱环节</view>
    </view>
    <view class="entry-arrow">></view>
  </view>

  <view class="tip">
    <view class="tip-title">覆盖考点</view>
    <view class="tip-kps">三角函数 · 对数 · 指数 · 方程 · 不等式 · 导数</view>
    <view class="tip-kps">积分 · 数列 · 概率 · 向量 · 解析几何</view>
  </view>
</scroll-view>

<!--input.wxml-->
<navigation-bar title="错题录入" back="{{true}}" color="black" background="#f3efe7"></navigation-bar>
<scroll-view class="page" scroll-y type="list">
  <view class="card">
    <view class="label">
      <text class="required">*</text> 错题题干
      <text class="counter">{{questionLen}}/2000</text>
    </view>
    <textarea
      class="textarea question"
      placeholder="请在此完整输入错题题干"
      placeholder-class="ph"
      maxlength="2000"
      value="{{question}}"
      bindinput="onQuestionInput"
      auto-height
    />
  </view>

  <view class="card">
    <view class="label">
      错误作答（选填）
      <text class="counter">{{answerLen}}/1000</text>
    </view>
    <textarea
      class="textarea answer"
      placeholder="填写你的错误答案，AI 将精准定位错因"
      placeholder-class="ph"
      maxlength="1000"
      value="{{wrongAnswer}}"
      bindinput="onAnswerInput"
      auto-height
    />
  </view>

  <view class="btn-wrap">
    <button class="submit-btn" disabled="{{submitting}}" loading="{{submitting && !streamChars}}" bindtap="onSubmit">
      {{submitting ? 'AI 诊断中…' : '开始智能解析'}}
    </button>
  </view>

  <view class="stream-box" wx:if="{{submitting && streamChars}}">
    <view class="stream-title">AI 正在实时生成诊断</view>
    <view class="stream-dots">
      <view class="dot"></view>
      <view class="dot d2"></view>
      <view class="dot d3"></view>
    </view>
    <view class="stream-progress">已生成 {{streamChars}} 字，完成后自动跳转诊断报告…</view>
  </view>

  <view class="hint" wx:if="{{!submitting}}">提示：诊断过程 AI 实时生成，请耐心等待</view>
</scroll-view>

<!--result.wxml-->
<navigation-bar title="诊断报告" back="{{true}}" color="black" background="#f3efe7"></navigation-bar>
<scroll-view class="page" scroll-y type="list">
  <block wx:if="{{result}}">
    <view class="kp-bar">
      <text class="kp-tag">考点：{{result.knowledgePoint}}</text>
      <text class="source-tag" wx:if="{{result.source === 'rule'}}">规则引擎</text>
    </view>
    <view class="conf-bar" wx:if="{{result.confidence !== undefined}}">
      <text class="conf-label">综合可信度</text>
      <view class="conf-track">
        <view class="conf-fill" style="width: {{result.confidence}}%;"></view>
      </view>
      <text class="conf-value">{{result.confidence}}%</text>
    </view>

    <view class="btn-wrap">
      <button class="again-btn" bindtap="goAgain">再诊断一道错题</button>
    </view>

    <!-- 模块一：题目展示 -->
    <view class="card">
      <view class="card-title">题目展示</view>
      <view class="question-text">{{result.question}}</view>
    </view>

    <!-- 模块二：错因诊断 -->
    <view class="card">
      <view class="card-title">错因诊断</view>
      <view class="body-text">{{result.diagnosis}}</view>
      <view class="cause-tree" wx:if="{{result.causeNodes && result.causeNodes.length}}">
        <view class="cause-tree-root">{{result.knowledgePoint}} · 错因定位</view>
        <view class="cause-tree-leaf" wx:for="{{result.causeNodes}}" wx:key="id">
          <view class="leaf-dot"></view>
          <text class="leaf-cat" wx:if="{{item.category}}">{{item.category}}</text>
          <text class="leaf-text">{{item.name}}</text>
        </view>
      </view>
    </view>

    <!-- 模块三：引导式追问 -->
    <view class="card">
      <view class="card-title">追问 AI 老师</view>
      <view class="chat-guide" wx:if="{{!chat.length}}">没看懂？继续追问，AI 老师会用提问引导你自己想通</view>
      <view class="chat-list" wx:if="{{chat.length}}">
        <view class="chat-item {{item.role}}" wx:for="{{chat}}" wx:key="index">
          <view class="chat-bubble">{{item.content}}</view>
        </view>
        <view class="chat-thinking" wx:if="{{chatting}}">AI 老师思考中…</view>
      </view>
      <view class="chat-input-row">
        <input
          class="chat-input"
          placeholder="针对这道题继续提问…"
          value="{{chatInput}}"
          bindinput="onChatInput"
          confirm-type="send"
          bindconfirm="sendChat"
          disabled="{{chatting}}"
        />
        <view class="chat-send {{chatting ? 'disabled' : ''}}" bindtap="sendChat">发送</view>
      </view>
    </view>

    <!-- 模块四：答题步骤（分步引导） -->
    <view class="card">
      <view class="card-title">答题步骤</view>
      <view class="guide">先思考问题，想不通再点「看提示」，仍不会可点「看完整解答」对照分步推理</view>
      <view class="step" wx:for="{{result.steps}}" wx:key="index">
        <view class="step-dot">{{index + 1}}</view>
        <view class="step-body">
          <view class="step-text">{{item.question}}</view>
          <view class="step-btns">
            <view class="step-hint-btn" bindtap="toggleHint" data-index="{{index}}" wx:if="{{item.hint}}">
              {{item.showHint ? '收起提示' : '看提示'}}
            </view>
            <view class="step-detail-btn" bindtap="toggleDetail" data-index="{{index}}" wx:if="{{item.detail}}">
              {{item.showDetail ? '收起完整解答' : '看完整解答'}}
            </view>
          </view>
          <view class="step-hint" wx:if="{{item.showHint && item.hint}}">{{item.hint}}</view>
          <view class="step-detail" wx:if="{{item.showDetail && item.detail}}">{{item.detail}}</view>
        </view>
      </view>
      <view class="solution-toggle" bindtap="toggleSolution" wx:if="{{result.solution}}">
        <text>查看完整正确解答（汇总版）</text>
        <view class="toggle-icon">{{solutionExpanded ? '-' : '+'}}</view>
      </view>
      <view class="solution-body" wx:if="{{solutionExpanded && result.solution}}">{{result.solution}}</view>
    </view>

    <!-- 模块五：变式题训练（难度分级） -->
    <view class="card">
      <view class="card-title">变式题训练</view>
      <view class="variant" wx:for="{{result.variants}}" wx:key="index">
        <view class="variant-q">
          <text class="variant-badge">{{item.level}}</text>
          {{item.question}}
        </view>
        <view class="variant-toggle" bindtap="toggleVariant" data-index="{{index}}">
          <text>{{item.expanded ? '收起参考答案与解析' : '展开参考答案与解析'}}</text>
          <view class="toggle-icon">{{item.expanded ? '-' : '+'}}</view>
        </view>
        <view wx:if="{{item.expanded}}" class="variant-detail">
          <view class="variant-answer">参考答案：{{item.answer}}</view>
          <view class="variant-analysis">解析：{{item.analysis}}</view>
        </view>
      </view>
    </view>
  </block>
</scroll-view>

<!--stats.wxml-->
<navigation-bar title="学情分析" back="{{true}}" color="black" background="#f3efe7"></navigation-bar>
<scroll-view class="page" scroll-y type="list">
  <!-- 空状态 -->
  <view class="empty" wx:if="{{!total}}">
    <view class="empty-icon">空</view>
    <view class="empty-text">还没有错题数据，诊断几道题后再来看看</view>
  </view>

  <block wx:if="{{total}}">
    <!-- 总览 -->
    <view class="overview">
      <view class="ov-item">
        <view class="ov-num">{{total}}</view>
        <view class="ov-label">累计错题</view>
      </view>
      <view class="ov-item">
        <view class="ov-num small">{{topKp}}</view>
        <view class="ov-label">最高频考点</view>
      </view>
      <view class="ov-item">
        <view class="ov-num small">{{topCause || '待积累'}}</view>
        <view class="ov-label">最高频错因</view>
      </view>
    </view>

    <!-- 考点分布 -->
    <view class="card">
      <view class="card-title">考点错题分布</view>
      <view class="bar-row" wx:for="{{kpStats}}" wx:key="name">
        <view class="bar-name">{{item.name}}</view>
        <view class="bar-track">
          <view class="bar-fill" style="width: {{item.percent}}%;"></view>
        </view>
        <view class="bar-count">{{item.count}} 题 · {{item.percent}}%</view>
      </view>
    </view>

    <!-- 错因节点排行 -->
    <view class="card" wx:if="{{causeStats.length}}">
      <view class="card-title">错因节点排行</view>
      <view class="bar-row" wx:for="{{causeStats}}" wx:key="name">
        <view class="bar-name cause">{{index + 1}}. {{item.name}}</view>
        <view class="bar-track">
          <view class="bar-fill orange" style="width: {{item.percent}}%;"></view>
        </view>
        <view class="bar-count">{{item.count}}</view>
      </view>
    </view>
    <view class="card" wx:else>
      <view class="card-title">错因节点排行</view>
      <view class="tip-text">升级后的诊断会自动匹配错因节点，再诊断几道题即可生成排行</view>
    </view>

    <!-- 错因树（完整三层：考点 -> 错因大类 -> 节点） -->
    <view class="card" wx:if="{{causeTree.length}}">
      <view class="card-title">错因树</view>
      <view class="tree-guide">完整错因地图：高亮为出现过的错因，灰色 ×0 为未触碰节点</view>
      <view class="tree-branch" wx:for="{{causeTree}}" wx:key="name">
        <view class="branch-head {{item.count ? '' : 'empty'}}" bindtap="toggleBranch" data-index="{{index}}">
          <text class="branch-arrow">{{item.expanded ? '-' : '+'}}</text>
          <text class="branch-name">{{item.name}}</text>
          <text class="branch-count">{{item.count}} 次</text>
        </view>
        <block wx:if="{{item.expanded}}">
          <view class="tree-cat" wx:for="{{item.categories}}" wx:for-item="cat" wx:key="name">
            <view class="cat-head">
              <view class="cat-dot"></view>
              <text class="cat-name">{{cat.name}}</text>
              <text class="cat-count">{{cat.count}} 次</text>
            </view>
            <view class="branch-leaf {{leaf.count ? '' : 'zero'}}" wx:for="{{cat.children}}" wx:for-item="leaf" wx:key="name">
              <view class="leaf-dot"></view>
              <text class="leaf-name">{{leaf.name}}</text>
              <text class="leaf-count">×{{leaf.count}}</text>
            </view>
          </view>
        </block>
      </view>
    </view>

    <view class="advice" wx:if="{{topKp}}">
      学情建议：你在「{{topKp}}」上出错最多，建议优先复习该章节的核心公式与适用前提，配合变式题巩固。
    </view>
  </block>
</scroll-view>
